en: Black‑and‑white photograph of a multi‑story mountainside hotel building with shutters on the windows. Large painted letters on the facade read "ALBERGO MIRAVALLE." The hotel stands on a sloping hillside, with rocky Alpine peaks rising in the background and some sparse vegetation and low stone structures in the foreground. The image is framed with a white border typical of vintage postcards.
